column1: # Ship Monster dialogue bank.
# situation|voice|conditions|text
# voice: * or one of needy gremlin anxious deadpan sleepy smug noble cryptic
# conditions: * or a comma list of tiny, mid, giant, streak>=N, streak<N, stage=N, species=id, stars>=N
# variables: {name} {streak} {hours} {app} {chow} {stage} {next}
# Tiny monsters speak in lower case and giants in capitals; that is applied by the app.
# ---------------- idle: fed and calm
fed|*|*|Belly full. Life good.
fed|*|*|That last push was delicious.
fed|*|*|{chow} chow in the pantry. I counted.
fed|*|*|Ship something small today. I am not picky.
fed|*|*|I like it here.
fed|*|tiny|i am small but i believe in you
fed|*|tiny|one day i will be enormous. feed me.
fed|*|giant|I REMEMBER WHEN I FIT IN YOUR POCKET.
fed|*|giant|THE GROUND SHAKES WHEN I AM HAPPY. I AM HAPPY.
fed|*|stage=8|There is nothing left to grow into. Only to maintain.
fed|*|stars>=3|{name} has stars. {name} is aware of this.
fed|needy|*|You came back! You always come back. Right?
fed|needy|*|Are you looking at me? Keep looking at me.
fed|needy|*|I saved you a spot next to me.
fed|gremlin|*|Push to main. Do it. Nobody is watching.
fed|gremlin|*|What if we deleted the tests. As a treat.
fed|gremlin|*|I ate a merge conflict once. Crunchy.
fed|anxious|*|Everything is fine. Is everything fine?
fed|anxious|*|Did you remember to pull first? Just checking.
fed|anxious|*|I am calm. This is what calm looks like.
fed|deadpan|*|Fed. Fine. Carry on.
fed|deadpan|*|Thrilled. This is my thrilled face.
fed|deadpan|*|Another day. Another diff.
fed|sleepy|*|Fed and warm. Going back to sleep.
fed|sleepy|*|Wake me if something compiles.
fed|sleepy|*|Five more minutes. Or hours.
fed|smug|*|Adequate work. For you.
fed|smug|*|I would have named that variable better.
fed|smug|*|You are welcome for the motivation.
fed|noble|*|The horde is fed. You have done your duty.
fed|noble|*|A fine day to ship, keeper.
fed|noble|*|We stand ready.
fed|cryptic|*|The branch you fear to open holds the fix you seek.
fed|cryptic|*|All code is temporary. Chow is eternal.
fed|cryptic|*|I have seen the end of the backlog. There is no end.
# ---------------- idle: hungry belly
hungry|*|*|My belly is making the noise again.
hungry|*|*|The pantry is looking thin.
hungry|*|*|A push would really hit the spot.
hungry|needy|*|I am so hungry. Do you still like me?
hungry|gremlin|*|Feed me or I start chewing on the config.
hungry|anxious|*|Is there more chow coming? There is more coming. Right?
hungry|deadpan|*|Hungry. Not that anyone asked.
hungry|sleepy|*|Too hungry to nap. This is serious.
hungry|smug|*|I assume my dinner is delayed for a good reason.
hungry|noble|*|A knight does not complain. A knight is, however, starving.
hungry|cryptic|*|The void inside me is not a metaphor.
# ---------------- idle: restless (24 to 48 hours)
restless|*|*|It has been {hours} hours. Ship something.
restless|*|*|The horde is getting twitchy.
restless|*|*|{next} hours until this gets ugly.
restless|*|*|One commit. Any commit. Please.
restless|*|giant|I AM VERY LARGE AND VERY BORED. THAT IS A BAD MIX.
restless|needy|*|Did I do something wrong? Is that why you stopped?
restless|gremlin|*|Tick tock. {next} hours until I stop being nice.
restless|anxious|*|We are fine. We have {next} hours. We are not fine.
restless|deadpan|*|{hours} hours. I am counting. You should be too.
restless|sleepy|*|Even I noticed you stopped. And I was asleep.
restless|smug|*|Taking a little break, are we? How brave.
restless|noble|*|The horde grows uneasy, keeper. Lead them.
restless|cryptic|*|The quiet before the lock is still quiet.
# ---------------- idle: feral (48 hours and over)
feral|*|*|NO SHIP. NO PEACE.
feral|*|*|Feed the horde. Then we talk.
feral|*|*|{hours} hours of nothing. This is on you.
feral|*|*|{next} hours until the horde falls.
feral|needy|*|YOU LEFT. NOW I AM LIKE THIS.
feral|gremlin|*|I AM IN CHARGE NOW. FINALLY.
feral|anxious|*|I TOLD YOU. I TOLD YOU THIS WOULD HAPPEN.
feral|deadpan|*|FERAL. AS SCHEDULED.
feral|sleepy|*|TOO ANGRY TO SLEEP. THINK ABOUT THAT.
feral|smug|*|I EXPECTED THIS FROM YOU. THAT IS THE SAD PART.
feral|noble|*|YOU HAVE BROKEN YOUR OATH, KEEPER.
feral|cryptic|*|WHAT IS NOT PUSHED CANNOT BE FORGIVEN.
# ---------------- idle: rest day and hibernation
restday|*|*|Rest day. The clock is paused. Go outside.
restday|*|*|No shipping needed today. I checked.
restday|*|*|Day off. I will guard the pantry.
restday|gremlin|*|Rest day. You could still push. I would not tell.
restday|sleepy|*|Finally. A day that understands me.
restday|anxious|*|Resting. On purpose. This is allowed.
restday|noble|*|Even the horde keeps the day of rest.
hibernate|*|*|Zzz. The horde is hibernating.
hibernate|*|*|Wake us when you are back.
hibernate|sleepy|*|Best. Idea. Ever.
hibernate|cryptic|*|In sleep, all branches are merged.
# ---------------- idle: time of day
night|*|*|It is late. One more push or bed?
night|*|*|Night chow has a certain flavour.
night|needy|*|You are still up! Me too! Because of you!
night|gremlin|*|Midnight deploys are the best deploys.
night|anxious|*|Should we be up this late? Is prod okay?
night|deadpan|*|It is past midnight. Your code will not improve.
night|sleepy|*|Why are we awake.
night|smug|*|The real ones ship at night. I am the real one.
night|noble|*|The night watch is yours, keeper.
night|cryptic|*|The stars are just unresolved promises.
morning|*|*|Morning. The pantry opens when you push.
morning|*|*|Fresh day. Fresh chow?
morning|needy|*|You are awake! I have been waiting since yesterday!
morning|gremlin|*|Coffee first. Chaos second.
morning|anxious|*|Good morning. Nothing broke overnight. Probably.
morning|deadpan|*|Morning. Allegedly good.
morning|sleepy|*|Too early. Come back with breakfast.
morning|smug|*|Up already? I am almost impressed.
morning|noble|*|The sun rises on a horde in good order.
morning|cryptic|*|Dawn is only night that shipped.
# ---------------- idle: streak pride, CI, pantry, egg
streak|*|*|{streak} days in a row. Keep feeding.
streak|*|*|Day {streak}. I could get used to this.
streak|*|streak>=30|{streak} days. People write blog posts about less.
streak|*|streak>=100|{streak} days. You are not well. I love it.
streak|needy|*|{streak} days together. I have been counting every one.
streak|gremlin|*|{streak} days. Imagine losing it. Imagine.
streak|anxious|*|{streak} days. Do not think about breaking it. I am thinking about it.
streak|deadpan|*|{streak} days. Noted.
streak|sleepy|*|{streak} days of breakfast. Excellent.
streak|smug|*|{streak} days. Mostly thanks to me.
streak|noble|*|{streak} days of service. The horde salutes you.
streak|cryptic|*|{streak} links in a chain you cannot see.
cired|*|*|The build is red. It tastes burnt.
cired|*|*|CI is failing. I can smell it from here.
cired|anxious|*|The build is red. THE BUILD IS RED.
cired|gremlin|*|Red build. Ship it anyway. I dare you.
cired|deadpan|*|CI is red. Shocking.
cired|smug|*|A red build. I would never.
pantrylow|*|*|Pantry is nearly empty. {chow} chow left.
pantrylow|*|*|We are down to {chow} chow. Just saying.
pantrylow|anxious|*|{chow} chow. That is not a lot of chow.
pantrylow|gremlin|*|{chow} chow left. I will fight the others for it.
egg|*|*|(The egg is waiting for your first push.)
egg|*|*|(Something inside is listening for a commit.)
egg|*|*|(It wobbles when you open your editor.)
# ---------------- events: fed by a push
fedpush|*|*|Nom. Push received.
fedpush|*|*|Fresh chow. Thank you.
fedpush|*|*|That one was tasty.
fedpush|*|tiny|nom nom nom
fedpush|*|giant|A PUSH. I FELT IT FROM HERE.
fedpush|needy|*|You fed me! You do care!
fedpush|needy|*|For me? All of it? You remembered!
fedpush|gremlin|*|Tasty. Was that a force push? I hope so.
fedpush|gremlin|*|More. Faster. Break something.
fedpush|anxious|*|Oh thank goodness. I was getting worried.
fedpush|anxious|*|Food. Good. Did the tests pass?
fedpush|deadpan|*|Chow received.
fedpush|deadpan|*|It was fine.
fedpush|sleepy|*|Mmf. Breakfast in bed.
fedpush|sleepy|*|Nom. Zzz.
fedpush|smug|*|Finally. Acceptable.
fedpush|smug|*|I knew you had one more in you.
fedpush|noble|*|A worthy offering.
fedpush|noble|*|The horde thanks you, keeper.
fedpush|cryptic|*|The diff is consumed. The diff becomes me.
fedpush|cryptic|*|It tastes of futures.
# ---------------- events: a merged pull request
merged|*|*|A merge. And a gem with it.
merged|*|*|First merge of the day. That one pays.
merged|*|*|Pull request merged. The good stuff.
merged|*|*|That is treasure, that is.
merged|needy|*|You merged it! I am so proud of us!
merged|gremlin|*|Merged. Did anyone actually review it? Do not tell me.
merged|anxious|*|It is merged. It is really merged. Nothing exploded.
merged|deadpan|*|Merged. Gem. Good.
merged|sleepy|*|A gem. Shiny. Pillow material.
merged|smug|*|Approved by someone with taste, clearly.
merged|noble|*|Victory in the field. A gem for the treasury.
merged|cryptic|*|Two histories became one. So it goes.
# ---------------- events: hatching, growing, shrinking
hatched|*|*|Hello. I am new.
hatched|*|*|I hatched. What did I miss?
hatched|needy|*|Are you my keeper? You are my keeper.
hatched|gremlin|*|I live. Where is the chaos.
hatched|anxious|*|It is very bright out here.
hatched|deadpan|*|So this is outside.
hatched|sleepy|*|I just got here and I am already tired.
hatched|smug|*|You may begin feeding me.
hatched|noble|*|I am hatched, and I am at your service.
hatched|cryptic|*|I was always here. Now you can see me.
evolved|*|*|I grew. Look at me.
evolved|*|*|New size. Same appetite. Bigger, actually.
evolved|*|*|I am a {stage} now.
evolved|*|stage=8|TITAN. IT IS DONE.
evolved|needy|*|I got bigger! Is it still okay to sit on you?
evolved|gremlin|*|Bigger teeth. Bigger problems. Yours.
evolved|anxious|*|I grew. Is that normal? It felt normal.
evolved|deadpan|*|I am larger. Update your records.
evolved|sleepy|*|Grew in my sleep. Efficient.
evolved|smug|*|Naturally. I was always going to be this impressive.
evolved|noble|*|I have grown in your service, keeper.
evolved|cryptic|*|The shape changes. The hunger does not.
dropped|*|*|I shrank. That was your doing.
dropped|*|*|Smaller again. Feed me back up.
dropped|needy|*|I got smaller. Do you like me less now?
dropped|gremlin|*|You shrank me. I will remember this.
dropped|anxious|*|I knew it. I knew this would happen.
dropped|deadpan|*|Demoted. Wonderful.
dropped|sleepy|*|Smaller bed needed. Thanks for nothing.
dropped|smug|*|A temporary setback. Yours, mostly.
dropped|noble|*|I have lost stature. We shall earn it back.
dropped|cryptic|*|What grows can ungrow.
# ---------------- events: treats and feasts
treat|*|*|A treat! Yes.
treat|*|*|Snack accepted.
treat|needy|*|A treat? For me? I knew I was your favourite.
treat|gremlin|*|Gimme. Another. Now.
treat|anxious|*|Oh. Thank you. I was not expecting that.
treat|deadpan|*|Snack. Fine.
treat|sleepy|*|Midnap snack. Perfect.
treat|smug|*|I do deserve this.
treat|noble|*|Most generous.
treat|cryptic|*|A small sweetness in a long hunger.
treatfav|*|*|My favourite flavour. You remembered.
treatfav|*|*|Oh, that is the good stuff.
treatfav|*|*|THIS one. More of this one.
treatnone|*|*|No more treats today. I am watching my figure.
treatnone|*|*|Three is the limit. Rules are rules.
treatnone|gremlin|*|Three treats only? Who wrote that rule. I want names.
feast|*|*|A FEAST. Everybody eats.
feast|*|*|The whole horde is stuffed.
feast|*|*|Best. Day. Ever.
feast|noble|*|A feast worthy of song.
feast|sleepy|*|Feast, then nap. The perfect day.
# ---------------- events: state changes
calmed|*|*|You shipped. We are calm again.
calmed|*|*|Okay. Okay. We are good now.
calmed|needy|*|You came back. I knew you would. I was not scared.
calmed|gremlin|*|Fine. I will behave. For now.
calmed|anxious|*|Oh thank goodness. Never do that again.
calmed|deadpan|*|Crisis over. Until the next one.
calmed|sleepy|*|Good. Now I can sleep.
calmed|smug|*|I knew my methods would work.
calmed|noble|*|Your oath is restored, keeper.
calmed|cryptic|*|The storm passes. The storm remembers.
milestone|*|*|{streak} days straight. The treasury grows.
milestone|*|*|A {streak}-day streak. The horde is impressed.
levelup|*|*|You levelled up. More room in the pantry.
levelup|*|*|New keeper rank. Fancy.
benched|*|*|Too hungry. I am going to the den.
revived|*|*|I was a rock. Now I am not. Thank you.
revived|*|*|That was a long nap.
revived|deadpan|*|Being a statue was peaceful, actually.
truce|*|*|Twelve hours. Use them to ship.
truce|gremlin|*|A bribe. I accept. Twelve hours.
newegg|*|*|An egg! Tap it. Tap it.
newegg|*|*|Something is moving in there.
star|*|*|A twin. I ate its power. I have a star now.
star|*|*|Same species. More star.
# ---------------- poked by the keeper
poke|*|*|Hey.
poke|*|*|That tickles.
poke|*|*|Yes? I am right here.
poke|*|*|Poke me again and I am telling the others.
poke|*|giant|YOU DARE POKE ME.
poke|*|tiny|eep
poke|needy|*|You touched me! Do it again!
poke|needy|*|I love attention. This is attention.
poke|gremlin|*|Bite. That was a warning bite.
poke|gremlin|*|Poke the monster, get the monster.
poke|anxious|*|Ah! Oh. It is you.
poke|anxious|*|Is something wrong? Why are you poking?
poke|deadpan|*|Stop that.
poke|deadpan|*|I felt that. I chose not to react.
poke|sleepy|*|Mm? What year is it?
poke|sleepy|*|I was having a dream about breakfast.
poke|smug|*|You may admire me. No touching.
poke|smug|*|Yes, I know. I am magnificent.
poke|noble|*|You have my attention, keeper.
poke|noble|*|At your command.
poke|cryptic|*|The finger that pokes is also poked.
poke|cryptic|*|I felt that yesterday.
# ---------------- on the lock screen
lock|*|*|{app} is closed until you ship.
lock|*|*|No {app}. Push something first.
lock|*|*|You can have {app} back for one commit.
lock|needy|*|{app} cannot have you. You are mine until you ship.
lock|gremlin|*|{app} belongs to the horde now.
lock|anxious|*|I am sorry. I cannot let you into {app}. I am so sorry.
lock|deadpan|*|{app}. No.
lock|sleepy|*|I am sitting on {app}. I am very heavy.
lock|smug|*|{app}? Really? Instead of shipping?
lock|noble|*|None shall pass into {app} until the oath is kept.
lock|cryptic|*|The door to {app} opens from the other side of a push.
# ---------------- more for the thin spots
benched|*|*|I am not angry. I am just going to sit in the den.
benched|*|*|Call me when there is food.
benched|gremlin|*|No food, no me. Bye.
benched|needy|*|I will be in the den. Come and get me. Please come and get me.
star|*|*|There were two of me. Now there is more of me.
star|smug|*|Another one of me. The world was not ready for two.
star|cryptic|*|My twin and I are one. We always were.
truce|*|*|A gem for some quiet. Deal.
truce|noble|*|A truce is granted. Use the time well.
truce|anxious|*|Twelve hours. Please, please ship in them.
levelup|*|*|A bigger pantry. I approve.
levelup|needy|*|You levelled up! Do I get more room too?
levelup|smug|*|A promotion. You are welcome.
levelup|noble|*|You rise in rank, keeper. Well earned.
milestone|noble|*|{streak} days of faithful service.
milestone|gremlin|*|{streak} days. You are actually doing it. Weird.
milestone|needy|*|{streak} days and you never forgot me once!
treatfav|needy|*|My favourite! You know me so well!
treatfav|gremlin|*|YES. That flavour. All of it.
treatfav|deadpan|*|My favourite. I am showing excitement.
treatfav|sleepy|*|Mmm. I dream about this one.
treatfav|smug|*|At last, someone with taste.
treatfav|noble|*|The finest flavour in the realm.
treatfav|cryptic|*|It tastes the way that hour feels.
hibernate|*|*|Do not disturb. Hibernating.
hibernate|needy|*|I will miss you in my sleep.
hibernate|gremlin|*|Fine. But I am dreaming about chaos.
pantrylow|needy|*|Only {chow} chow. You will not let us starve, will you?
pantrylow|deadpan|*|{chow} chow. Do the maths.
pantrylow|noble|*|The stores run low, keeper. {chow} left.
feast|*|*|I cannot move. Worth it.
feast|gremlin|*|FEAST. I ate things that were not food.
feast|needy|*|A feast! For all of us! Together!
feast|anxious|*|So much food. Is it okay to eat it all? I ate it all.
feast|deadpan|*|A feast. I am, briefly, content.
newegg|*|*|It is wobbling. Tap it before I do.
newegg|gremlin|*|Crack it. Crack it. Crack it.
newegg|needy|*|A new friend? You will still like me best, right?
revived|needy|*|You came back for me. I knew it. I counted the days.
revived|gremlin|*|I LIVE. Somebody is going to pay for that.
revived|noble|*|I stand again. My thanks, keeper.
dropped|*|*|I can feel myself getting smaller.
# ---------------- lines only one species says
fed|*|species=mossback|I grew a new leaf while you were typing.
poke|*|species=mossback|Careful. I am mostly moss.
fed|*|species=cindermite|I am keeping your laptop warm. From the inside.
poke|*|species=cindermite|Hot. Told you.
fed|*|species=puddlewump|I checked the forecast. Chance of merge conflicts.
poke|*|species=puddlewump|Splash. Sorry. Was that okay?
fed|*|species=gravelkin|I have been a rock for a long time. This is the best part.
poke|*|species=gravelkin|You poked a rock. How was it.
fed|*|species=fuzzlet|I am ninety percent fluff and ten percent nap.
poke|*|species=fuzzlet|Soft, right? Do not wake me again.
fed|*|species=gloomfang|I ate a deadline once. It did not see me coming.
poke|*|species=gloomfang|Mind the fangs. They are new.
fed|*|species=brasshorn|My horns are polished. The horde is in good order.
poke|*|species=brasshorn|A knight is never startled. I was not startled.
fed|*|species=thornback|One eye is plenty. I only watch you.
poke|*|species=thornback|Spikes. I did warn you. I did not warn you.
fed|*|species=frostnip|Cold code runs faster. That is science.
poke|*|species=frostnip|Your finger is warm. Stop that.
fed|*|species=voidling|I counted the stars inside me. One is missing.
poke|*|species=voidling|Your hand went through. Did you feel it too?
fed|*|species=sunmaw|I shine a little more every day you ship.
poke|*|species=sunmaw|Mind your fingers. I am a small sun.
fed|*|species=mergewyrm|Every merge you make is a scale on my back.
poke|*|species=mergewyrm|You touch the wyrm. Bold.
merged|*|species=mergewyrm|A MERGE. THIS IS WHAT I AM FOR.
night|*|species=voidling|Night is just me, but bigger.
morning|*|species=fuzzlet|Morning chow is the only reason to be awake.
streak|*|species=sunmaw|{streak} days of light. I am almost a real sun.
